provenance.fg-rest: table.tsx's own base className carries no unconditional text-colour utility on <table> itself — inherits the page's own foreground, the SAME slot every prior shadcn column's own fg/foreground token resolves to (globals.css --foreground).
provenance.muted-bg: TableFooter's own bg-muted/50; TableRow's own hover:bg-muted/50 and data-[state=selected]:bg-muted — globals.css --muted, the SAME slot toggle-group.shadcn.json's own muted-bg already resolved.
provenance.muted-fg: TableHead's own text-foreground uses a DIFFERENT token (see structure.header-cell), but TableCaption's own text-muted-foreground uses this one — globals.css --muted-foreground.
provenance.border: TableHeader's own [&_tr]:border-b, TableRow's own border-b, TableFooter's own border-t — all THREE use the bare, unmodified `border-b`/`border-t` utility (no border-input/border-ring override anywhere in table.tsx), which resolves to Tailwind's own DEFAULT border-color theme value, globals.css --border (NOT --input, a distinct token from the one this pipeline's other shadcn columns often cite for form-control borders).
provenance.tanstack-selection-wiring: row.getIsSelected() (TanStack's own row-model API) drives data-state={row.getIsSelected() && "selected"} on TableRow — confirmed directly in app/(app)/examples/tasks/components/data-table.tsx:103 and registry/new-york-v4/blocks/dashboard-01/components/data-table.tsx:321. The base <TableRow>'s own data-[state=selected]:bg-muted rule is real and reachable, but only becomes meaningful once this EXTERNAL, unvendored engine sets the attribute — see the template's own behavior.pattern/behavior.row-selection notes.
provenance.expandable-row-hook-out-of-scope: TableRow's own class string also carries has-aria-expanded:bg-muted/50 — a real, reachable expandable-row style hook, structurally identical in shape to the selection hook above (consumer/external-engine-driven), but OUT OF SCOPE for this build per the matrix doc's own scope note (expandable/nested rows) — recorded here for completeness, not modelled as its own row.
provenance.docs-vs-source: content/docs/components/base/data-table.mdx states directly: 'So instead of a data-table component, I thought it would be more helpful to provide a guide on how to build your own.' — confirming the data-table guide is explicitly NOT a shipped component, consistent with @tanstack/react-table being an installed-but-unvendored dependency.
